answers.why: The genealogy names Bela, Becher, and Jediael as Benjamin's three sons.
Manasseh is named as Machir's father in the genealogy.
Ephraim mourns as their father, receives comfort from his brothers, and then fathers another son.
Israel is identified as Joseph's father.
Benjamin begets Bela his firstborn and other named sons.
All Israel are collectively registered by genealogies.
Judah's people are exiled to Babylon for their transgression.
Manasseh belongs to the list of tribal populations dwelling in Jerusalem.
Judah is named as the father of Perez in Uthai's ancestry.
The Philistines fight Israel's forces in the battle involving Saul.
The men of Israel flee from the Philistines and fall slain at Gilboa.
Israel's men in the valley abandon their cities after Saul and his sons die.
